name: Barchan Bloom
a: A crescent sand dune at the bottom centre of the frame sprouts a tall green cactus that shoots up to the top of the frame and bursts into pink flowers.
b: A burst of pink cactus flowers, green spines and tan sand
snd: sand hissing, a quick woody stretch, then a soft bursting pop

name: Spine Roller
a: A ball of green cactus covered in long pale spines, rolling in place like a dung ball, with a few tan pebbles stuck in it.
b: A burst of pale cactus spines flying outward with tan stone chips
snd: a heavy prickly ball rolling fast, then a sharp burst of needles

name: Brine Blossom
a: A salt pool seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: pale turquoise water with a white salt crust rim and pink cactus flowers floating on it, slowly turning.
b: A fountain of turquoise water, white salt crystals and pink petals bursting straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame
snd: salty water bubbling and fizzing, then a splashing fountain

name: Mirror Salt
a: A beam of golden-white light drops from the top of the frame onto a flat mirror of shallow water at the bottom centre, which flashes and throws the light back up.
b: A burst of golden-white light with white salt crystals and water drops
snd: a bright shimmering beam striking still water with a glassy ring

name: Dead Sea
a: A black salt lake seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: dark water with a violet sheen and a rim of grey salt, turning slowly round a pitch black centre.
b: A column of dark water with violet glints and grey salt flakes bursting straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame
snd: a slow thick dark gurgle sinking, then a heavy wet surge

name: Nimbus Wade
a: A flamingo's wing made of pink glass and salt water unfolds upward from the bottom centre to the top of the frame, with green leaves and a soft pale nimbus of light behind it.
b: A burst of pink glassy feathers, water drops and green leaves
snd: a great wing opening with a wet whoosh and soft glassy chimes

name: Salt Sun
a: A ball of white salt crystal with a turquoise watery glow inside, rolling in place, bright as a small sun.
b: A burst of white salt shards and turquoise water spray
snd: a crunchy crystalline ball rolling fast, then a sharp salty shatter

name: Shell and Stilt
a: A long thin leg of pink glass with a clawed foot stamps straight down from the top of the frame to the bottom centre into shallow water over stone.
b: A burst of water spray and tan stone chips in a ring
snd: one sharp stamping step into shallow water with a crack of stone

name: Salt Wind
a: A swirl of white salt crystals and pink feathers carried in a spinning gust of pale wind, turning in place.
b: A burst of salt spray, pink feathers and wind streaks
snd: a stinging gust of gritty wind rushing past, then a dry hissing burst

name: Regent's Rings
a: Two ringed feelers of turquoise water with bright bands start at the left and right edges of the frame, curl inward and wind together into a tight spiral in the centre.
b: A burst of turquoise water rings spreading outward with droplets
snd: two streams of water winding together fast, then a ringing splash

name: Glass Dune
a: A jagged branch of golden lightning glass drops from the top of the frame and stabs into a tan sand dune at the bottom centre, glowing white-gold.
b: A burst of golden glass shards, light and tan sand
snd: a bolt hitting sand with a crack and a glassy tinkle

name: Buried Sun
a: Dark sand pours in from the left and right edges of the frame and closes over a dim violet sun in the centre until only a thin ring of light is left.
b: A burst of dark sand with a ring of violet light
snd: sand pouring and closing in with a low smothering rumble

name: Year Rings
a: Concentric rings of polished brass and tan stone, like the rings of a tortoise shell, start wide at the edges of the frame and close inward one after another to the centre.
b: A burst of brass ring fragments and tan stone chips
snd: heavy brass rings clanging shut one after another, then a deep knock

name: Ringtail Bolt
a: A ring of brass with yellow lightning crackling round it and two small glass dragonfly wings, spinning in place.
b: A burst of yellow lightning and brass ring fragments
snd: a buzzing electric whirr darting past, then a metallic zap

name: False Sun Flower
a: A tall cactus of white-gold light rises from the bottom centre to the top of the frame and opens a flower of light at its tip, with two small mock suns either side of it.
b: A burst of white-gold petals and light with green spines
snd: a warm rising shimmer opening into a bright soft chord

name: Crystal Hump
a: A great orange crystal, glowing hot from inside, drops from the top of the frame onto a brass-ringed stone dome at the bottom centre and splits.
b: A burst of hot orange crystal shards and brass sparks
snd: a heavy crystal dropping and cracking apart with a hot hiss

name: Pool Current
a: A shallow pool seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: turquoise water with yellow lightning running round it in rings, slowly turning.
b: A column of water and yellow lightning bursting straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame
snd: water crackling with electricity, building into a snapping surge

name: Parhelion
a: Three suns in a row at the top of the frame, a bright one between two fainter mock suns joined by a thin halo arc; all three fire beams of white-gold light and yellow lightning down to one point at the bottom centre.
b: A burst of white-gold light and yellow lightning rays
snd: three bright beams striking at once with an electric shimmer

name: Black Sun Dog
a: A black sun with a violet halo at the top of the frame, between two small dark mock suns; violet lightning forks down from it to the bottom centre.
b: A burst of violet lightning round a black disc
snd: a deep dark hum, then a harsh violet electric crack

name: Brass Saguaro
a: A tall saguaro cactus with two arms, banded in polished brass rings and tan stone, thrusts up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of brass bands, green spines and tan stone chips
snd: something heavy thrusting up through stone with a brassy clang

name: Heat Shimmer
a: A wavering ball of orange heat haze with yellow sparks, and two small glass dragonfly wings of flame, flickering in place.
b: A burst of orange flame and yellow sparks with heat ripples
snd: a dry hot buzzing rush, then a fiery crackling pop

name: Corona Frill
a: A lizard's frill made of yellow lightning and turquoise water opens wide into a full disc filling the frame, then snaps shut to the centre.
b: A burst of yellow lightning rays and water spray, like a sun's corona
snd: a sudden crackling fan snapping open and shut with an electric splash

name: Ring Runner
a: A ring of white-gold light with yellow sparks trailing from it and a streak of wind, rolling in place.
b: A small burst of yellow sparks and wind streaks
snd: three fast zipping passes with small electric cracks

name: Fulgurite Garden
a: Branches of golden lightning glass grow up from tan sand at the bottom centre to the top of the frame, budding small green cactus pads and pink flowers.
b: A burst of golden glass shards, green pads and pink petals
snd: glass crackling as it grows, then a bright tinkling shatter

name: Gilded Barrel
a: A barrel cactus banded in gold, glowing white-gold, seen falling straight down: the cactus at the bottom centre of the frame, with golden light and tan dust streaming straight up behind it to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of golden light, pale spines and tan stone chips
snd: something heavy falling with a bright whistle and landing with a prickly crunch

name: Dawn Darner
a: A dragonfly shape made of white-gold light with four glass wings, seen from above, wings beating fast in place, with small yellow sparks.
b: A burst of white-gold light and yellow sparks
snd: a bright buzzing dart past, then a sparkling electric chime

name: Dusk Darner
a: A dragonfly shape of black with thin violet lightning along its four wings, seen from above, wings beating fast in place.
b: A burst of violet lightning and dark smoke
snd: a dark buzzing dart past, then a harsh crackling snap

name: Storm Feelers
a: Two long ringed feelers of yellow lightning whip down from the top of the frame, crossing, and strike one point at the bottom centre, with curling wind.
b: A burst of yellow lightning arcs and wind streaks
snd: two whips of lightning cracking down one after the other

name: Stilt Spark
a: A long thin leg of pink glass crackling with yellow lightning stamps straight down from the top of the frame to the bottom centre, where green leaves scatter.
b: A burst of yellow sparks, pink glass slivers and green leaves
snd: one sharp electric stamp with a glassy crack

name: Oasis That Isn't
a: A mirage pool seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: shimmering dark water with a faint upside-down palm reflection and violet heat haze, slowly turning.
b: A column of violet haze and tan sand rising straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame, wavering
snd: a wavering dreamy shimmer, then a hollow rushing collapse

name: Lake Lightning
a: A fountain of turquoise salt water rises from the bottom centre to the top of the frame with yellow lightning climbing up through it.
b: A burst of water spray and yellow lightning
snd: water surging up with crackling electricity and a sharp snap

name: Hot Air
a: A wavering pillar of violet heat haze rises from the bottom centre to the top of the frame, with pink feathers and wind streaks spiralling up inside it.
b: A burst of violet haze, pink feathers and wind
snd: hot wind rising with an eerie wavering whistle

name: Sprint Tide
a: A wheel of white-gold light with turquoise water spraying off its rim, spinning fast in place.
b: A burst of water spray and white-gold light
snd: a fast spinning wheel rushing through water, then a bright splash

name: Undertow
a: A dark whirl seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: black water with violet streaks spinning fast round a pitch black centre, with grey salt foam.
b: A column of black water with violet glints bursting straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame
snd: a fast dark whirlpool sucking down, then a heavy wet surge

name: False Oasis
a: A shimmering oasis of palm trees and water appears across the frame in violet heat haze, then folds in from both sides like a closing book and vanishes to a point in the centre.
b: A burst of violet haze and wind with tan sand
snd: a shimmering mirage wavering, then snapping shut with a hollow whoosh
